 Order

Dated this the 03rd day of December, 2025 The petitioners are the accused persons in C.C No. 355 of 2014 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Ponnani, arising out of Crime No.
203 of 2014 of Ponnani Police station.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Ponnani
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The offences alleged against the petitioners are under Sections 498A, 406 r/w 34 of the IPC.

2. The prosecution case is that the 1st accused, being the husband of the defacto complainant subjected her to cruelty both physically and mentally on the ground of dowry, misappropriated her gold and thereby they alleged to have committed the aforesaid offences.

3. According to the learned counsel for the petitioners, now the matter has been settled with the defacto complainant and therefore, the petitioners prayed for quashing all further proceedings against them.

The learned counsel for the defacto complainant/2nd respondent also submitted that the matter has been settled between the parties and therefore, she also prayed for quashing all Alangatt Ashraf vs State Of Kerala on 3 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144508209/

entities.text: Alangatt Ashraf vs State Of Kerala
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. The petitioners also produced the agreement entered into between the defacto complainant and the petitioners, amicably settled all the dispute pending between them.
In paragraph 5 of the said agreement, also specifically stated that the parties have agreed to settle and put an end to the present case registered against the petitioners.
Along with the Crl.M.C., an CRL.MC NO. 1220 OF 2021 2025:KER:93454 affidavit has also been filed stating that the matter has been settled.

In the light of above circumstances, this Crl.M.C is liable to be allowed and all further proceedings against the petitioners in C.C No. No. 355 of 2014 on the file of Judicial First Class Magistrate Court,
Ponnani is liable to be quashed.
